name: The Frost Dragon
description: This card arrives when the Oracle wants you to stop measuring your progress against the calendar. The Frost Dragon does not hurry, and nothing it has built has ever needed to be built twice.
message: What you are working toward is already moving beneath the surface, the way glaciers reshape mountains without anyone watching it happen. Trust the pace even when it feels like nothing is changing.
guidance: Choose the slower, sturdier path today. A foundation laid patiently will outlast one laid in a hurry.
warning: Do not mistake stillness for failure. The Dragon warns against abandoning something simply because it has not yet finished becoming itself.

name: The Storm Griffin
meaning: Vision, independence, the courage to be strange
description: The Storm Griffin circles high above the noise of the present moment, drawn when the Oracle senses you already know something the room around you hasn't caught up to yet.
message: An idea you have been quietly nursing deserves more air than you've given it. What looks unconventional to others may simply be early.
guidance: Speak the unpopular thought. Chart the new sky rather than waiting for permission to leave the flock.
warning: Beware circling so high that you lose contact with the ground entirely. Vision without landing is only wandering.

name: The Moonlit Kraken
meaning: Intuition, dreaming, the permeable border between feeling and knowing
description: Drawn from waters no light reaches, this card surfaces when logic has run out of answers and something quieter needs to be trusted instead.
message: A feeling you cannot yet explain in words is nonetheless accurate. The Kraken asks you to listen to it before you try to justify it.
guidance: Let a decision rest overnight before you act on it. Dreams and intuitions are archives, not distractions.
warning: Do not let the depth of a feeling become an excuse to stay submerged in it. Surface long enough to act.

name: The Flamehorn Ram
description: This card is drawn for the person standing at the edge of something, waiting for a sign that will never arrive because the sign was always meant to be their own first step.
message: The Oracle will not talk you out of the leap. What you begin today does not need to be perfect — it only needs to be begun.
guidance: Take the first bold action, even a small one. Momentum is easier to steer than stillness is to start.
warning: The Ram warns against charging so fast that you trample something worth protecting, including your own rest.

name: The Emerald Minotaur
description: Guardian of a garden hidden at the center of the oldest maze, this card is drawn when devotion is quietly being tested and needs reaffirming, not abandoning.
message: Something you have committed to is worth the slow, patient tending it still requires. The reward is not visible yet because it isn't finished growing.
guidance: Recommit to a promise you made, to another person or to yourself. Show your strength through steadiness, not spectacle.
warning: Beware confusing loyalty with stubbornness. Not every labyrinth is worth staying in forever.

name: The Twin-Tailed Sylph
meaning: Duality, adaptability, two truths at once
description: Born of a single breath split into two winds, this card appears when you are holding two things that seem to contradict each other and neither one is wrong.
message: You do not have to choose between the two paths pulling at you today. There is room for both, even if the room feels smaller than you'd like.
guidance: Let both truths speak instead of silencing one to please the other. Curiosity will serve you better than certainty right now.
warning: The Sylph warns against never landing. At some point, one wind must be followed, at least for a while.

name: The Pearl Serpent
description: Coiled around the last shell of a sunken temple, this card is drawn when something precious in your life needs to be defended, gently but without hesitation.
message: Your instinct to protect what you've built is not overreaction. Trust it, and act on it before the tide changes.
guidance: Set the boundary you've been avoiding. Devotion is not weakness — it becomes strength the moment it's tested.
warning: Do not let protectiveness curdle into control. What you guard should still be free to breathe.

name: The Phoenix
description: No creature in the twelve orders has ended and returned more often. This card marks a closing that is, quietly, already the opening act of something better.
message: What just ended was not a defeat. The Phoenix reminds you that every one of its endings has been followed by something brighter than what came before.
guidance: Let the ash finish settling before you build again — but do not doubt that you will build again.
warning: Beware rushing your own rebirth. Even the Phoenix rests in the fire before it rises.

name: The Whispering Sphinx
description: Guardian of the oldest threshold, this card appears when something is not quite what it seems, and a closer look is warranted before you proceed.
message: A detail you've noticed but dismissed deserves a second look. The Sphinx rewards those patient enough to ask one more question.
guidance: Slow down before committing your trust. Precision now will save you a harder correction later.
warning: The Sphinx warns against becoming so guarded that no one is ever given the chance to earn your trust at all.

name: The Twilight Chimera
meaning: Balance, fairness, the beauty of the in-between
description: Formed in the hour the sky cannot decide between gold and violet, this card is drawn when a conflict needs a peacemaker rather than a winner.
message: Neither side of the disagreement you're facing holds the entire truth. The Oracle asks you to hold the middle a little longer than feels comfortable.
guidance: Seek the compromise rather than the victory. Fairness will serve you longer than being right.
warning: Beware balancing so carefully that you never actually choose. Some moments do ask you to pick a side.

name: The Shadow Basilisk
description: Guardian of a door the underworld left open, this card marks a change too significant to undo, arriving whether or not you feel ready for it.
message: Something in you is already different than it was a season ago. Stop pretending otherwise for the comfort of people who liked who you used to be.
guidance: Face the transformation directly instead of around its edges. What changes you now will not diminish you.
warning: The Basilisk warns against seeking intensity for its own sake. Not every door needs to be opened to prove your courage.

name: The Starforged Wyvern
description: Hatched from a star that refused to stay fixed, this card arrives when routine has grown too small for whoever is holding it.
message: The restlessness you've been feeling is not a flaw to fix. It's a compass pointing toward ground you haven't stood on yet.
guidance: Plan the departure, literal or otherwise. New paths only forge themselves once someone is willing to wander first.
warning: Beware wandering so far you lose the thread back to what actually mattered to you before you left.
